cache:
  enabled: true
  dir: /data/cache
  port: 8088
  proxy_port: 8089
container:
  docker_host: "-"
  workdir_parent: shared/workdir
host:
  workdir_parent: /data/act
kubernetes:
  namespace: forgejo
  poll_timeout: 10m
log:
  level: info
plugins:
  k8s:
    address: "unix:///plugin/forgejo-runner-k8s.sock"
    options:
      namespace: forgejo
      poll_timeout: 10m
      labels: "app.kubernetes.io/name=forgejo-runner-instance"
      resources: |
        requests:
          memory: 256Mi
        limits:
          memory: 1Gi
runner:
  capacity: 5
  labels:
    - ubuntu-latest:k8s:/config/podspec-default.yaml
    - self-hosted:k8s:/config/podspec-dind.yaml
    - default:k8s:/config/podspec-default.yaml
    - docker:k8s:/config/podspec-dind.yaml
  timeout: 3h
  shutdown_timeout: 3m

containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: FORGEJO_RUNNER_K8S_LOG_JOB_OUTPUT
        value: true
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 4Gi
restartPolicy: Never

initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
      - name: FORGEJO_RUNNER_K8S_LOG_JOB_OUTPUT
        value: true
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 4Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    ephemeral:
      volumeClaimTemplate:
        metadata:
          labels:
             app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: forgejo-runner-codeberg
        spec:
          storageClassName: local-hostpath
          accessModes:
            - ReadWriteOnce
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 5Gi
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
restartPolicy: Never

apk add --no-cache openssl >/dev/null
mkdir -p /data/tls
if [ ! -f /data/tls/privkey.pem ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout /data/tls/privkey.pem \
    -out /data/tls/fullchain.pem \
    -subj "/CN=mail.sa7mie.se"
  echo "Created bootstrap self-signed TLS cert in /data/tls"
fi

setup:
  codecov_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}
  codecov_api_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}

  debug: no
  loglvl: INFO

  guest_access: off
  admins:
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Saphir
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Alexsaphir

  http:
    cookies_domain: {{.Values.codecov.host }}

  timeseries:
    enabled: false
  ta_timeseries:
    enabled: false

  telemetry:
    enabled: false

gitlab_enterprise:
  enabled: true
  url: https://gitlab.${DOMAIN_NAME}
  global_upload_token_enabled: false

  bot:
    username: Codecov

services:
  redis_url: redis://dragonfly.database.svc.cluster.local:6379/4
  minio:
    host: minio.minio-system.svc.cluster.local
    bucket: codecov
    region: us-east-1
    verify_ssl: false
    port: 9000

notifications:
  slack: off
  gitter: off
  webhook: off
  irc: off
  hipchat: off
